title: 高層建築差異縮短補償
summary: 超高層的柱與核心筒在重力、潛變與收縮下持續縮短，若兩者縮短量不同，樓板會傾斜，連接構件與外伸臂會鎖入附加力，帷幕牆與電梯也會被拉扯。本課從縮短的三個來源與「安裝後縮短」的觀念出發，談構件尺寸、鋼—混凝土混合系統、標高補償、延遲接合時機、振弦式應變計與測量回饋，到非結構構件的容許變形與竣工後的長期追蹤，並以樂天世界塔、哈里發塔與世界貿易中心一號大樓的公開做法為例。
summaryEn: In a supertall building, columns and cores keep shortening under gravity, creep and shrinkage; when they shorten by different amounts, floors tilt, connecting members and outriggers lock in extra forces, and façades and elevators are strained. Starting from the three sources of shortening and the idea of post-installation shortening, the course covers member size, steel–concrete hybrid systems, level compensation, timing of delayed connections, vibrating-wire gauges and survey feedback, then tolerances of non-structural elements and long-term tracking after completion, illustrated by public practice at Lotte World Tower, Burj Khalifa and One World Trade Center.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「縮短的三個來源」與「安裝後縮短與中段最大」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Three sources of shortening" and "Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 縮短的三個來源：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Three sources of shortening: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 混凝土豎向構件的縮短由三部分組成：加載時立即發生的彈性應變、在持續荷載下隨時間增加的潛變，以及與荷載無關、因水分散失而產生的收縮。潛變大致與應力成正比，通常以潛變係數 φ 乘上彈性應變表示；收縮則取決於濕度、構件尺寸與配比。周邊柱與核心牆的應力水準、斷面尺寸與加載時程不同，三部分加總後的總應變就不同，每層的差值會沿高度累積成數十毫米的差異縮短。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shortening of vertical concrete members has three parts: elastic strain that occurs immediately on loading, creep that grows with time under sustained load, and shrinkage that is independent of load and results from moisture loss. Creep is roughly proportional to stress and is usually expressed as a creep coefficient φ times the elastic strain; shrinkage depends on humidity, member size and mix. Perimeter columns and core walls differ in stress level, section size and loading history, so the sum of the three strains differs, and the storey-by-storey difference accumulates up the height into tens of millimetres of differential shortening. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 縮短的三個來源
knowledge.text: 混凝土豎向構件的縮短由三部分組成：加載時立即發生的彈性應變、在持續荷載下隨時間增加的潛變，以及與荷載無關、因水分散失而產生的收縮。潛變大致與應力成正比，通常以潛變係數 φ 乘上彈性應變表示；收縮則取決於濕度、構件尺寸與配比。
knowledge.textEn: Shortening of vertical concrete members has three parts: elastic strain that occurs immediately on loading, creep that grows with time under sustained load, and shrinkage that is independent of load and results from moisture loss. Creep is roughly proportional to stress and is usually expressed as a creep coefficient φ times the elastic strain; shrinkage depends on humidity, member size and mix.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「高層建築差異縮短補償」的「縮短的三個來源：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「高樓模型整合室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Three sources of shortening: mechanism and load path” in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Tower model integration room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「縮短的三個來源」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Three sources of shortening" is correct?
options: 柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。
混凝土豎向構件的縮短由三部分組成：加載時立即發生的彈性應變、在持續荷載下隨時間增加的潛變，以及與荷載無關、因水分散失而產生的收縮。
樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。
optionsEn: A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant.

Shortening of vertical concrete members has three parts: elastic strain that occurs immediately on loading, creep that grows with time under sustained load, and shrinkage that is independent of load and results from moisture loss.
The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs.
quiz.explanation: 混凝土豎向構件的縮短由三部分組成：加載時立即發生的彈性應變、在持續荷載下隨時間增加的潛變，以及與荷載無關、因水分散失而產生的收縮。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shortening of vertical concrete members has three parts: elastic strain that occurs immediately on loading, creep that grows with time under sustained load, and shrinkage that is independent of load and results from moisture loss. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 縮短的三個來源：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Three sources of shortening: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。柱：σ = 20 MPa、E = 40 GPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 200 με → 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με；核心牆：σ = 10 MPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 300 με → 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με。差值 525 με，在 4 m 層高等於每層約 2.1 mm。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh. For a column with σ = 20 MPa, E = 40 GPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 200 με: 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με; for a core wall with σ = 10 MPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 300 με: 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με. The 525 με difference is about 2.1 mm per 4 m storey. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型；再比較 ACI 209、fib Model Code 與試驗擬合三種預測的差異，把差異範圍當作補償值的不確定性區間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model; compare predictions from ACI 209, the fib Model Code and the test fit to define an uncertainty band.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。柱：σ = 20 MPa、E = 40 GPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 200 με → 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με；核心牆：σ = 10 MPa、φ = 1.5、ε_sh = 300 με → 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με。差值 525 με，在 4 m 層高等於每層約 2.1 mm。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh. For a column with σ = 20 MPa, E = 40 GPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 200 με: 500 + 750 + 200 = 1,450 με; for a core wall with σ = 10 MPa, φ = 1.5 and ε_sh = 300 με: 250 + 375 + 300 = 925 με. The 525 με difference is about 2.1 mm per 4 m storey. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「縮短的三個來源」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Three sources of shortening", which statement holds?
options: 鋼柱沒有潛變，所以鋼—混凝土混合塔樓不會有差異縮短問題。
延遲接頭越晚鎖定越好，沒有任何代價。
總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。
optionsEn: Steel columns do not creep, so steel–concrete hybrid towers have no differential-shortening problem.
Delay joints should always be locked as late as possible at no cost.
Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh.
quiz.explanation: 總應變 ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Total strain ε = (σ/E)(1 + φ) + ε_sh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 縮短的三個來源：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Three sources of shortening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型；再比較 ACI 209、fib Model Code 與試驗擬合三種預測的差異，把差異範圍當作補償值的不確定性區間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model; compare predictions from ACI 209, the fib Model Code and the test fit to define an uncertainty band. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：設計初期就把柱與核心牆的應力比列為控制目標，並在規範中要求以實際配比做潛變收縮試驗，試驗結果須在主要結構施工前回饋到預測模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Treat the column-to-core stress ratio as a design target from the outset, and require creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes in the specification, with results fed back into the prediction model before major structural work begins.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只計算彈性縮短而忽略潛變與收縮，長期差異縮短可能被低估兩到三倍，完工數年後周邊樓板仍持續下沉，電梯門檻與帷幕牆接縫逐漸超出調整範圍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Computing only elastic shortening and ignoring creep and shrinkage can underestimate long-term differential shortening by two to three times, so perimeter floors keep dropping for years after completion and elevator sills and façade joints gradually run out of adjustment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型；再比較 ACI 209、fib Model Code 與試驗擬合三種預測的差異，把差異範圍當作補償值的不確定性區間。
knowledge.textEn: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model; compare predictions from ACI 209, the fib Model Code and the test fit to define an uncertainty band.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設計初期就把柱與核心牆的應力比列為控制目標，並在規範中要求以實際配比做潛變收縮試驗，試驗結果須在主要結構施工前回饋到預測模型。
knowledge.textEn: Treat the column-to-core stress ratio as a design target from the outset, and require creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes in the specification, with results fed back into the prediction model before major structural work begins.

quiz.question: 要驗證「縮短的三個來源」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Three sources of shortening"?
options: 以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
設計階段的縮短預測一旦完成，施工中就不需要再修改。
optionsEn: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A design-stage shortening prediction never needs revising during construction.
quiz.explanation: 以實際配比做潛變與收縮試驗（例如依 ASTM C512 與 C157），擬合潛變係數與收縮終值，代入預測模型；再比較 ACI 209、fib Model Code 與試驗擬合三種預測的差異，把差異範圍當作補償值的不確定性區間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run creep and shrinkage tests on the actual mixes, for example to ASTM C512 and C157, fit the creep coefficient and ultimate shrinkage and feed them into the prediction model; compare predictions from ACI 209, the fib Model Code and the test fit to define an uncertainty band. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 縮短的三個來源：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Three sources of shortening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彈性、潛變與收縮應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elastic, creep and shrinkage strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只計算彈性縮短而忽略潛變與收縮，長期差異縮短可能被低估兩到三倍，完工數年後周邊樓板仍持續下沉，電梯門檻與帷幕牆接縫逐漸超出調整範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Computing only elastic shortening and ignoring creep and shrinkage can underestimate long-term differential shortening by two to three times, so perimeter floors keep dropping for years after completion and elevator sills and façade joints gradually run out of adjustment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：周邊柱與核心牆的應力水準、斷面尺寸與加載時程不同，三部分加總後的總應變就不同，每層的差值會沿高度累積成數十毫米的差異縮短。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Perimeter columns and core walls differ in stress level, section size and loading history, so the sum of the three strains differs, and the storey-by-storey difference accumulates up the height into tens of millimetres of differential shortening.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「柱子只在加載當下縮短，之後長度就不再改變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A column shortens only at the moment of loading and its length then stays constant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只計算彈性縮短而忽略潛變與收縮，長期差異縮短可能被低估兩到三倍，完工數年後周邊樓板仍持續下沉，電梯門檻與帷幕牆接縫逐漸超出調整範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Computing only elastic shortening and ignoring creep and shrinkage can underestimate long-term differential shortening by two to three times, so perimeter floors keep dropping for years after completion and elevator sills and façade joints gradually run out of adjustment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「縮短的三個來源」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Three sources of shortening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若只計算彈性縮短而忽略潛變與收縮，長期差異縮短可能被低估兩到三倍，完工數年後周邊樓板仍持續下沉，電梯門檻與帷幕牆接縫逐漸超出調整範圍。
樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

Computing only elastic shortening and ignoring creep and shrinkage can underestimate long-term differential shortening by two to three times, so perimeter floors keep dropping for years after completion and elevator sills and façade joints gradually run out of adjustment.
The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs.

quiz.explanationEn: Computing only elastic shortening and ignoring creep and shrinkage can underestimate long-term differential shortening by two to three times, so perimeter floors keep dropping for years after completion and elevator sills and façade joints gradually run out of adjustment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 安裝後縮短與中段最大：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「安裝後縮短曲線」如何影響高層建築差異縮短補償的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-installation shortening profile” governs force, deformation or durability in “Differential-shortening compensation in tall buildings”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 逐層施工時，每一層樓板都是在下方已經縮短之後才依設計標高施作，因此真正影響樓板高程與連接構件的，是該層安裝之後才發生的縮短。底部樓層安裝早，但其下方柱段很短；頂部樓層下方柱段很長，但安裝時上面已沒有新增荷重；結果安裝後縮短在中段附近最大，這與一次加載模型「越往上越大」的直覺相反。補償值因此必須依樓層逐一計算，而不是按高度比例分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「安裝後縮短曲線」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In storey-by-storey construction each floor is built to its design level after the structure below has already shortened, so what matters for floor levels and connecting members is the shortening that occurs after that floor is installed. Low floors are installed early but have little column below them; top floors have a long column below but receive almost no load after installation; post-installation shortening therefore peaks near mid-height, contrary to a one-step loading model in which shortening grows toward the top. Compensation must be computed floor by floor, not prorated by height. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Post-installation shortening profile” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：等斷面柱、每層荷重 P、每段勁度 k，第 i 層安裝後的彈性縮短 δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: For a uniform column with load P per floor and segment stiffness k, the elastic shortening after floor i is installed is δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「安裝後縮短曲線」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Post-installation shortening profile”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安裝後縮短與中段最大
knowledge.text: 逐層施工時，每一層樓板都是在下方已經縮短之後才依設計標高施作，因此真正影響樓板高程與連接構件的，是該層安裝之後才發生的縮短。底部樓層安裝早，但其下方柱段很短；頂部樓層下方柱段很長，但安裝時上面已沒有新增荷重；結果安裝後縮短在中段附近最大，這與一次加載模型「越往上越大」的直覺相反。
knowledge.textEn: In storey-by-storey construction each floor is built to its design level after the structure below has already shortened, so what matters for floor levels and connecting members is the shortening that occurs after that floor is installed. Low floors are installed early but have little column below them; top floors have a long column below but receive almost no load after installation; post-installation shortening therefore peaks near mid-height, contrary to a one-step loading model in which shortening grows toward the top.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安裝後縮短與中段最大」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height" is correct?
options: 樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。
同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。

optionsEn: The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs.
The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column.

In storey-by-storey construction each floor is built to its design level after the structure below has already shortened, so what matters for floor levels and connecting members is the shortening that occurs after that floor is installed.
quiz.explanation: 逐層施工時，每一層樓板都是在下方已經縮短之後才依設計標高施作，因此真正影響樓板高程與連接構件的，是該層安裝之後才發生的縮短。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In storey-by-storey construction each floor is built to its design level after the structure below has already shortened, so what matters for floor levels and connecting members is the shortening that occurs after that floor is installed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安裝後縮短與中段最大：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安裝後縮短曲線」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-installation shortening profile” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：等斷面柱、每層荷重 P、每段勁度 k，第 i 層安裝後的彈性縮短 δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k。N = 100、P/k = 0.01 mm：δ₂₅ = 25×75×0.01 ≈ 18.8 mm，δ₅₀ = 25.0 mm（最大），δ₇₅ ≈ 18.8 mm，δ₁₀₀ = 0。數值為教學假設，未含時間相依效應。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: For a uniform column with load P per floor and segment stiffness k, the elastic shortening after floor i is installed is δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k. With N = 100 and P/k = 0.01 mm: δ₂₅ = 25×75×0.01 ≈ 18.8 mm, δ₅₀ = 25.0 mm (maximum), δ₇₅ ≈ 18.8 mm and δ₁₀₀ = 0. Values are teaching assumptions without time-dependent effects. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以施工階段分析逐層啟動構件與荷重，輸出每層安裝後的縮短曲線，並以手算 i(N − i) 型式核對趨勢；施工中每隔數層以精密水準量測樓板相對於設計標高的偏差，檢查實測曲線形狀是否與預測一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Activate members and loads floor by floor in a construction-stage analysis and output the post-installation shortening profile, checking its trend against the hand-derived i(N − i) form; during construction, level-survey floor deviations from design elevations every few floors and check that the measured profile matches the predicted shape.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 等斷面柱、每層荷重 P、每段勁度 k，第 i 層安裝後的彈性縮短 δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k。N = 100、P/k = 0.01 mm：δ₂₅ = 25×75×0.01 ≈ 18.8 mm，δ₅₀ = 25.0 mm（最大），δ₇₅ ≈ 18.8 mm，δ₁₀₀ = 0。數值為教學假設，未含時間相依效應。
knowledge.textEn: For a uniform column with load P per floor and segment stiffness k, the elastic shortening after floor i is installed is δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k. With N = 100 and P/k = 0.01 mm: δ₂₅ = 25×75×0.01 ≈ 18.8 mm, δ₅₀ = 25.0 mm (maximum), δ₇₅ ≈ 18.8 mm and δ₁₀₀ = 0. Values are teaching assumptions without time-dependent effects.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安裝後縮短與中段最大」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height", which statement holds?
options: 等斷面柱、每層荷重 P、每段勁度 k，第 i 層安裝後的彈性縮短 δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k。
差異縮短只能在完工後以調整裝修高度來處理。
應變計讀到的應變全部都是荷載造成的。
optionsEn: For a uniform column with load P per floor and segment stiffness k, the elastic shortening after floor i is installed is δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k.
Differential shortening can only be dealt with after completion by adjusting finish levels.
All strain read by a gauge is caused by load.
quiz.explanation: 等斷面柱、每層荷重 P、每段勁度 k，第 i 層安裝後的彈性縮短 δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: For a uniform column with load P per floor and segment stiffness k, the elastic shortening after floor i is installed is δ_i = i(N − i)·P/k. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安裝後縮短與中段最大：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「安裝後縮短曲線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-installation shortening profile” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以施工階段分析逐層啟動構件與荷重，輸出每層安裝後的縮短曲線，並以手算 i(N − i) 型式核對趨勢；施工中每隔數層以精密水準量測樓板相對於設計標高的偏差，檢查實測曲線形狀是否與預測一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Activate members and loads floor by floor in a construction-stage analysis and output the post-installation shortening profile, checking its trend against the hand-derived i(N − i) form; during construction, level-survey floor deviations from design elevations every few floors and check that the measured profile matches the predicted shape. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：補償表應明確區分「總縮短」與「安裝後縮短」，並註明採用的施工速度假設；施工進度若明顯變快或變慢，須由結構工程師重新計算後續樓層的補償值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compensation tables must distinguish total from post-installation shortening and state the assumed construction speed; if progress becomes much faster or slower, the structural engineer must recalculate compensation for later floors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若以一次加載模型的結果做補償，頂部樓層會被過度預抬、中段補償不足，完工後頂部樓板高於設計、中段低於設計，電梯導軌與管道立管被迫在現場切改。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compensating from a one-step loading model over-raises the top floors and under-compensates mid-height, leaving upper floors high and middle floors low after completion and forcing site modifications to elevator rails and risers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以施工階段分析逐層啟動構件與荷重，輸出每層安裝後的縮短曲線，並以手算 i(N − i) 型式核對趨勢；施工中每隔數層以精密水準量測樓板相對於設計標高的偏差，檢查實測曲線形狀是否與預測一致。
knowledge.textEn: Activate members and loads floor by floor in a construction-stage analysis and output the post-installation shortening profile, checking its trend against the hand-derived i(N − i) form; during construction, level-survey floor deviations from design elevations every few floors and check that the measured profile matches the predicted shape.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 補償表應明確區分「總縮短」與「安裝後縮短」，並註明採用的施工速度假設；施工進度若明顯變快或變慢，須由結構工程師重新計算後續樓層的補償值。
knowledge.textEn: Compensation tables must distinguish total from post-installation shortening and state the assumed construction speed; if progress becomes much faster or slower, the structural engineer must recalculate compensation for later floors.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安裝後縮短與中段最大」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以施工階段分析逐層啟動構件與荷重，輸出每層安裝後的縮短曲線，並以手算 i(N − i) 型式核對趨勢。

quiz.explanation: 以施工階段分析逐層啟動構件與荷重，輸出每層安裝後的縮短曲線，並以手算 i(N − i) 型式核對趨勢；施工中每隔數層以精密水準量測樓板相對於設計標高的偏差，檢查實測曲線形狀是否與預測一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Activate members and loads floor by floor in a construction-stage analysis and output the post-installation shortening profile, checking its trend against the hand-derived i(N − i) form; during construction, level-survey floor deviations from design elevations every few floors and check that the measured profile matches the predicted shape. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安裝後縮短與中段最大：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「安裝後縮短曲線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-installation shortening profile” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若以一次加載模型的結果做補償，頂部樓層會被過度預抬、中段補償不足，完工後頂部樓板高於設計、中段低於設計，電梯導軌與管道立管被迫在現場切改。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compensating from a one-step loading model over-raises the top floors and under-compensates mid-height, leaving upper floors high and middle floors low after completion and forcing site modifications to elevator rails and risers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：補償值因此必須依樓層逐一計算，而不是按高度比例分配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compensation must be computed floor by floor, not prorated by height.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「樓層越高，需要的縮短補償就越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the floor, the larger the shortening compensation it needs." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若以一次加載模型的結果做補償，頂部樓層會被過度預抬、中段補償不足，完工後頂部樓板高於設計、中段低於設計，電梯導軌與管道立管被迫在現場切改。
knowledge.textEn: Compensating from a one-step loading model over-raises the top floors and under-compensates mid-height, leaving upper floors high and middle floors low after completion and forcing site modifications to elevator rails and risers.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安裝後縮短與中段最大」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-installation shortening peaks at mid-height" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
同一配比的混凝土無論做成牆或柱，收縮量都一樣。
若以一次加載模型的結果做補償，頂部樓層會被過度預抬、中段補償不足，完工後頂部樓板高於設計、中段低於設計，電梯導軌與管道立管被迫在現場切改。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The same concrete mix shrinks the same amount whether it is cast as a wall or a column.

quiz.explanationEn: Compensating from a one-step loading model over-raises the top floors and under-compensates mid-height, leaving upper floors high and middle floors low after completion and forcing site modifications to elevator rails and risers. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
